died.name: Jim Jones
died.desc: American cult leader and mass murderer
died.cause: speaking to his followers, shortly after they had all been poisoned with cyanide. Jones died of a possibly self-inflicted gunshot wound to the head, while his followers died of cyanide poisoning
died.last_words: We didn't commit suicide, we committed an act of revolutionary suicide protesting the conditions of an inhumane world.

born.name: Karla Faye Tucker
born.desc: American double murderer who converted to Christianity in prison
born.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection
born.last_words: Yes sir, I would like to say to all of you-the Thornton Family and Jerry Dean's family that I am so sorry. I hope God will give you peace with this. Baby, I love you. Ron, give Peggy a hug for me. Everybody has been so good to me. I love all of you very much. I am going to be face to face with Jesus now. Warden Baggett, thank all of you so much. You have been so good to me. I love all of you very much. I will see you all when you get there. I will wait for you.
